name: Wayne Summer Day Camp
operator_name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Northwest New Jersey
description_short: Full day Boys & Girls Club camp at the air conditioned 36,000 square foot Wayne clubhouse for children entering kindergarten through grade 8, 7:15 AM to 6:30 PM. Kids play in two gyms, use the tech lab and game room, swim off site, and go on field trips that are included in tuition.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds until April 1, less a 5% processing fee. After that, refunds only if the spot can be filled, or in a family hardship.
notes: Eight weeks, June 29 to August 21, plus Vacation Club days August 24 to 26. Included trips: Monster Mini Golf and T-Bowl Bowling for all, Turtle Back Zoo, SkyZone and Frog Falls for K to 5, Ice Vault, Tomahawk Lake and Mountain Creek for grades 6 to 8. Optional trips and science and cooking classes cost extra. The page's 2026 price table didn't come through as text, so no price is recorded. Subsidy families contact the directors to register. The same club runs a separate Wayne Early Education Summer Camp.
